zh.nav_starnote_blog_title: 在辰记上阅读、关注与评论
zh.foot_powered_gh: 由 {brand} 发布到 GitHub Pages
zh.privacy_intro: 这是 {owner} 的个人博客，托管在 GitHub Pages 上，由辰记 StarNote 模板生成。本页说明本站会收集和保存哪些信息。
zh.privacy_local: 本站不设账号，不收集表单信息。浏览器本地存储（localStorage）只用来记住你选择的深浅色主题和 Cookie 选择，不会发送到任何服务器。
zh.privacy_host: 网站由 GitHub Pages 托管，GitHub 可能出于安全与运维记录访问者的 IP 地址，详见 GitHub 隐私声明：[GitHub Privacy Statement](https://docs.github.com/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement)。
zh.privacy_ads: 本站使用 Google AdSense 展示广告。只有在你点击「全部接受」（或在欧洲经济区、英国、瑞士通过 Google 认证的同意管理平台表示同意）后，Google 及其合作伙伴才会使用 Cookie 衡量访问并投放更相关的广告。你可以随时通过页脚的「Cookie 设置」更改选择，或在 [Google 广告设置](https://adssettings.google.com) 与 [aboutads.info](https://www.aboutads.info) 退出个性化广告。Google 如何使用合作伙伴网站的数据：[Google 合作伙伴网站说明](https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites)。
zh.privacy_starnote: 文章里的评论、阅读数等互动功能由辰记 StarNote 提供（如已开启），相关数据按 [辰记隐私政策]({app}/privacy) 处理。
zh.privacy_contact: 对本政策有疑问，请通过「联系」页与作者联系。
zh.comments_go_text: 这里展示最新 3 条评论。登录辰记即可回复、点赞，作者会在那里看到。

en.nav_starnote_blog_title: Read, follow and comment on StarNote
en.privacy_intro: This is the personal blog of {owner}, hosted on GitHub Pages and generated from the StarNote template. This page explains what this site collects and keeps.
en.privacy_local: There are no accounts and no forms here. Your browser's local storage (localStorage) only remembers your light/dark theme and cookie choice; it is never sent to a server.
en.privacy_host: The site is hosted by GitHub Pages; GitHub may log visitors' IP addresses for security and operations — see the [GitHub Privacy Statement](https://docs.github.com/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement).
en.privacy_ads: This site shows ads through Google AdSense. Only after you choose “Accept all” (or, in the EEA, the UK and Switzerland, consent through a Google-certified consent platform) do Google and its partners use cookies to measure visits and show more relevant ads. You can change your choice any time with “Cookie settings” in the footer, or opt out of personalised ads at [Google Ads Settings](https://adssettings.google.com) and [aboutads.info](https://www.aboutads.info). How Google uses data from partner sites: [Google partner sites](https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites).
en.privacy_starnote: Comments, read counts and other interactions on posts are provided by StarNote (when enabled) and handled under the [StarNote Privacy Policy]({app}/privacy).
en.privacy_contact: Questions about this policy? Reach the author through the Contact page.
en.comments_go_text: The newest 3 are shown here. Sign in to StarNote to reply or like — the author reads them there.
